package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// PositionCourseRepoPG implements PositionCourseRepository.
type PositionCourseRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Replace updates position course links to exact set.
func (r PositionCourseRepoPG) Replace(ctx context.Context, positionID int, courseIDs []string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM position_course WHERE position_id=$1`, positionID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, courseID := range courseIDs {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO position_course (position_id, course_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, positionID, courseID); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ListCourses returns localized course previews linked to the position.
func (r PositionCourseRepoPG) ListCourses(ctx context.Context, positionID int, lang string, onlyActive bool) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)

	args := []any{positionID, lang}
	argIdx := 3
	whereClause := "WHERE pc.position_id = $1"
	if onlyActive {
		whereClause += fmt.Sprintf(" AND c.status = $%d", argIdx)
		args = append(args, domain.CourseStatusActive)
	}

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`
WITH lang AS (
    SELECT id FROM i18n WHERE language = $2
)
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.slug,
    COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title) AS title,
    COALESCE(ci.description, ci_fallback.description) AS description
FROM position_course pc
JOIN course c ON c.id = pc.course_id
LEFT JOIN lang l ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = c.id AND l.id = ci.i18n_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ci2.title, ci2.description
    FROM course_i18n ci2
    WHERE ci2.course_id = c.id
    ORDER BY ci2.i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) ci_fallback ON TRUE
%s
ORDER BY COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title), c.slug`, whereClause), args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var courses []domain.CoursePreview
	for rows.Next() {
		var course domain.CoursePreview
		if err := rows.Scan(&course.ID, &course.Slug, &course.Title, &course.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		courses = append(courses, course)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return courses, nil
}

var _ repository.PositionCourseRepository = (*PositionCourseRepoPG)(nil)
